intro.subtitle: 叮叮當！敲壞不用賠！
intro.text:
[A native Taiwanese Hokkien (Tai-gi / Southern Min) speaking middle-aged male night-market boss. Deep chest voice, gravelly bass, tough macho energy, warm playful sarcasm. Speak fluent Taiwanese with natural connected-speech tone sandhi. The script is Tai-lo romanization, NOT English or Mandarin; never spell out letters or read these instructions. One voice only, dry close microphone, no music, no extra words. Booming street-vendor shout, punch each of the three bell syllables, confident invitation. About 3 seconds.]
Ting-ting-tang! Kòng-pháinn bián puê!

bent_heart.subtitle: 免賠啦！我心疼爾爾。
bent_heart.text:

Speak fluent Taiwanese with natural connected-speech tone sandhi. The script is Tai-lo romanization, NOT English or Mandarin; never spell out letters or read these instructions. success.subtitle: 保利達 B！！
success.text:
[A native Taiwanese Hokkien (Tai-gi / Southern Min) speaking middle-aged male night-market boss. Deep chest voice, gravelly bass, tough macho energy, warm playful sarcasm. Speak fluent Taiwanese with natural connected-speech tone sandhi. The script is Tai-lo romanization, NOT English or Mandarin; never spell out letters or read these instructions. One voice only, dry close microphone, no music, no extra words. Explosive triumphant victory shout, like a strongman winning. The famous Taiwanese brand Paolyta B: pronounce B as English bee.
